body.message:
Good Morning Mustafa,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the viewing of the Downtown View unit.

Unfortunately, the unit is fully booked at the moment, so we will not be able to arrange a viewing today. The earliest available date for viewing will be 30th September onwards.

Regarding JVC, please allow me some time to check the availability and I will update you accordingly.

In the meantime, could you please confirm your preferred start date and required duration in months for the JVC unit? This will help us check the most suitable options for you.

Thank you for your understanding.
